name: Minecraft Java (Fabric)
description: Fabric-based Minecraft Java Edition server using itzg/minecraft-server. Supports most modern Fabric mods (e.g. Sodium, Lithium, Iris, Fabric API, Simple Voice Chat). Drop mod jars into <instance_data>/mods/ on the host.
notes: Mods go in <data_root>/<instance_id>/mods/ on the keeper host. Restart the instance after adding mods. For modpacks distributed as CurseForge or Modrinth .zip, set AUTO_CURSEFORGE=1 or set MODRINTH_MODPACK=<slug/version> via a custom env override.
